name: Comprehensive Life Insurance Analysis
meta_description: Map your family's finances year by year after your death, including Social Security survivor benefits and college, to see how much life insurance you need.
subtitle: Build a year-by-year cash-flow plan for your survivors, with their income, Social Security survivor benefits, spending and college costs, and see how much life insurance would fill the gaps.

How the fund is sized

It is the smallest amount that, invested at your return, pays every year's shortfall and never runs dry. Surplus years are saved in the fund and help pay later gaps.

Survivor's year-by-year cash flow

Income, benefits and spending after your death in future dollars, and the fund that covers the gaps. The fund pays each gap at the start of the year.
